subject: skill:close
gist: A decision or term written only to knowledge homes needs no record
reason: Asked for by name with no change open, close writes a decision or a term into the knowledge homes without opening a change record, as the routing map now says too.

authorisedBy.words: The operator's cards of 2026-10-14 on part 2 of the-whole-change, each "Rule as proposed": a change is open while a session holds it and stopped when none does, set at every stop with its "next" line, and resuming sets it open; a new request that is not a follow-up stops the open change first; greenline status lists each open and stopped change with its "next" line; and a close asked for by name that writes only into the knowledge homes needs no change record

ruling.words: The operator's ruling R22 of 2026-10-08 on the re-cut brief, "yes amend, with one change": build's spine is incremental-implementation, implement being a stub, anticipate ships as a trial on the trial step, and domain-modeling splits, its questioning into frame and its glossary into close
